verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Connect lets platforms set the frequency of automatic payouts to connected accounts (docs-13). That is a recurring scheduled operation, but it is limited to payouts rather than general jobs or workflows. missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, scheduling exposed to AI or agent tooling (e.g. via the MCP server or CLI), detailed docs on schedule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
